kev.name: Cisco BroadWorks Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability
kev.description: Cisco BroadWorks contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system.

kev.name: Google Chromium Use-After-Free Vulnerability
kev.description: Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome…

kev.name: Microsoft Office Outlook Missing User Interaction for Potentially Unsafe Action Vulnerability
kev.description: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

kev.name: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
kev.description: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s…

kev.name: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability
kev.description: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience.

kev.name: Barracuda Networks Multiple Products OS Command Injection Vulnerability
kev.description: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated…

kev.name: IBM Aspera Faspex Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
kev.description: IBM Aspera Faspex contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to craft a specific message to bypass authorization, causing privilege escalations.

kev.name: OpenBSD OpenSSH Unexpected Status Code or Return Value Vulnerability
kev.description: OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.

kev.name: SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability
kev.description: SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution.

kev.name: GPUStack Improper Authentication Vulnerability
kev.description: GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml.

kev.name: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability
kev.description: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

kev.name: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
kev.description: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.

kev.name: WordPress WordPress Core Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition Vulnerability
kev.description: WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.

kev.name: Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability
kev.description: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

kev.name: Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
kev.description: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

kev.name: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Integer Overflow or Wraparound Vulnerability
kev.description: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

kev.product: Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software
kev.name: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software Unchecked Return Value to NULL Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
kev.description: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

kev.name: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
kev.description: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability…

kev.name: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
kev.description: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

kev.name: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
kev.description: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

kev.name: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
kev.description: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

kev.name: PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability
kev.description: PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

kev.name: PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability
kev.description: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

kev.name: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
kev.description: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. kev.name: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
kev.description: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

kev.name: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
kev.description: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

kev.name: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
kev.description: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

kev.name: Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
kev.description: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

kev.name: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
kev.description: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654…

kev.name: Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
kev.description: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

kev.name: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
kev.description: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

kev.name: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
kev.description: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

kev.name: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
kev.description: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

kev.name: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
kev.description: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated…

kev.name: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
kev.description: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

kev.name: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
kev.description: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

kev.name: Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
kev.description: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

kev.name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
kev.description: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.
